The Handlebar Tuesday Shop Ride

Ashland, OR · Downtown · Mountain bike

The Handlebar Tuesday Shop Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Ashland, OR. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from The Handlebar. Pace: intermediate.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: intermediate.
Check
Look at @handlebarashland the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Handlebar Tuesday Shop Ride group ride

A Tuesday mountain bike ride led by shop staff. Starts and ends at the shop and rides up and down the Ashland trail system. Pitched at intermediate riders. Bring your own bike, tools, food and lights.
